signals.title: Lewis Hamilton aims to extend career till early 2030s so he can race in African Grand Prix
signals.summary: 41-year-old set on ‘dream to be able to race in Africa’ Rwanda to host despite criticism of human rights record Lewis Hamilton has said he hopes to remain racing in Formula One until he can take part in the African Grand Prix which is set to take place in Rwanda in the 2030s . The seven-time world champion believes it is right that F1 is to hold a race there despite criticism of the country’s human rights record. Last week F1 confirmed Rwanda was to host the African Grand Prix having concluded a 10-year agreement for the meeting on a purpose-built circuit, with the first race set for the early 2030s. It is lined up to be held on a circuit in Bugesera, 25 miles south of the capital, Kigali, which has yet to be constructed and marks a return to the African continent for the first time since it last held a race at Kyalami, South Africa in 1993. signals.title: Automating ML for Science: Can Frontier Agents Climb Scientific Hills in the Wild?
signals.summary: arXiv:2610.28763v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Frontier coding agents are increasingly framed as end-to-end automated researchers, and ML for science offers a demanding test of that promise: improving a scientific model often requires domain insight beyond routine ML engineering. We introduce Agent4Sci, a long-horizon testbed for measuring how far today's agents can improve the published best models on scientific ML benchmarks, spanning 20 benchmarks across 11 domains. Rather than ranking agents on a leaderboard, Agent4Sci asks what kinds of progress agents can make on these tasks under in-the-wild conditions, and where they fall short. Empirically, today's frontier agents advance the published best on every benchmark, with Claude Opus reaching 10.4% mean relative improvement and no run flagged for academic misconduct. These gains, however, come almost entirely from a bag of ML-engineering tricks rather than research-level insight. Trajectory analysis surfaces three recurring limitations in this setting: novelty miscalibration, resource under-utilization, and rapid collapse into local engineering sweeps. signals.title: Forging More Tasks into Better Harnesses: Agentic Harness Evolution via Successive Scale Racing
signals.summary: arXiv:2610.28815v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agentic harness evolution optimizes an agent's instructions, tools, and control flow by using its task execution experiences as evolving evidence. While more evolution tasks should intuitively improve performance, our preliminary study reveals a paradoxical failure mode: the performance of existing methods degrades as the task pool expands. Our further analysis demonstrates that this degradation stems from suboptimal evidence selection during optimization, as different evidence combinations lead to substantially different evolution outcomes. To address this issue, we propose Successive Scale Racing (SSR), a framework that adaptively searches for optimal evidence combinations in each evolution round. SSR constructs diverse evidence combinations based on the corresponding task quality and coverage, and efficiently races the resulting candidate harnesses under a small compute budget. Empirically, across three distinct benchmarks, SSR achieves state-of-the-art results in all six configurations. signals.title: Hidden Messages Between Diffusion Language Model Agents: Causal Evidence for Latent Communication
signals.summary: arXiv:2610.28905v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Diffusion language models form answers through a sequence of revisable continuous states, but multi-agent systems usually discard those states and make agents communicate only after decoding text. We ask whether one independent diffusion trajectory can pass a compact hidden message into another and, crucially, whether the receiver uses what that message means. In Hidden Messages, a sender compresses its denoising state into four signed dense vectors; the receiver consumes them while retaining its own context, canvas, and trajectory. Removing a message tests whether the channel matters; replacing it with a message from another example tests whether its content matters. Across controlled tasks, derangement removes a +63.6-point advantage on Tiny-A2D and a +100.0-point advantage on Dream-7B, while targeted substitutions steer the receiver toward the substituted fact. evidence.title: Back Up Before You Regret: Measuring Backup Awareness and Automating Backup in Coding Agents
evidence.summary: arXiv:2610.28934v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coding agents now complete tasks autonomously, modifying real-world state such as artifacts, software environments, and configurations along the way. Yet they show limited backup awareness: recognizing that an action will modify state that may later be needed, and preserving it beforehand. evidence.title: PerMIT: Securing Persistent Memory for LLM Agents via Machine-Checked Integrity Theorems and Scalable Community Trust
evidence.summary: arXiv:2610.28987v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Persistent memory is a largely undefended surface for injection and poisoning, and the same risk limits memory sharing among agents. themes.title: Thương mại, xung đột và rủi ro chuỗi cung ứng
themes.reading: Các diễn biến chính trị và thương mại có thể ảnh hưởng đến vận tải, giá đầu vào hoặc quyết định đầu tư. Chưa thể suy ra tác động tới Việt Nam nếu chưa biết tuyến hàng, mặt hàng và mức độ phơi nhiễm.
themes.falsifier: Bác bỏ nếu chưa có thay đổi chính sách/luồng hàng thực tế hoặc mặt hàng liên quan không gắn với Việt Nam.

evidence.title: Families of missing Azerbaijanis call for support from European institutions
evidence.summary: Families of more than 4,000 Azerbaijanis still missing since the first Karabakh war brought their demand for answers to the EU institutions, hoping that the peace process between Armenia and Azerbaijan, after decades of suffering on both sides, could finally clarify the fate of their relatives.

evidence.title: Iran's Balochistan border region sees growing unrest
evidence.summary: Violence is on the rise in Iran's border region with Afghanistan and Pakistan. The Iran war could shift the strategic balance for militant groups operating in the area.

themes.title: Việt Nam: chính sách và điều kiện kinh doanh
themes.reading: Chỉ đáng nâng thành tín hiệu khi có văn bản hoặc số liệu gốc, phạm vi áp dụng và nhóm chịu tác động xác định được. Tin kinh doanh đơn lẻ chưa đủ để kết luận xu hướng kinh tế Việt Nam.
themes.falsifier: Bác bỏ nếu không có văn bản/số liệu gốc hoặc nội dung không tạo thay đổi đáng kể với doanh nghiệp.

evidence.title: Hà Tĩnh thu hút hơn 170.000 tỷ đồng vốn đầu tư vào các khu công nghiệp
evidence.summary: Hơn 9 tháng năm 2026, các khu kinh tế, khu công nghiệp Hà Tĩnh thu hút 24 dự án mới, tổng vốn đăng ký hơn 170.000 tỷ đồng, chủ yếu trong lĩnh vực luyện kim, năng lượng và sản xuất công nghiệp.

evidence.title: Thiếu lao động, ngành xây dựng tìm lời giải từ đào tạo đến tiền lương
evidence.summary: Trước tình trạng thiếu lao động trên nhiều công trường giao thông, các đơn vị đề xuất cải thiện chi phí nhân công, đào tạo mới lao động theo nhu cầu doanh nghiệp.

evidence.title: Vietnam Airlines đẩy mạnh khai thác thị trường Bỉ
evidence.summary: Vietnam Airlines ký kết biên bản ghi nhớ hợp tác và gia hạn hợp đồng tổng đại lý với APG Inc ngày 22/10, nhằm phát triển hoạt động thương mại tại thị trường Bỉ.

evidence.title: Người phụ nữ đưa gạo nếp Tài vùng cao ra thị trường
evidence.summary: Từ giống bí xanh thơm đến gạo nếp Tài, Ma Thị Ninh tìm cách đưa nông sản bản địa ra thị trường, giúp người dân thay đổi tập quán sản xuất và tạo sinh kế.
